doc: Which Matrix client each team opens in (Plan 00254 DESIGN-client-choice.md): a team's own client, else agent_bus_matrix_client, else lightning. One table read by src-go/internal/bus/declare/clients_test.go and the plan's test_acceptance_lightning.py, so the Go and the plan's Python resolve the same cases. The play's Jinja is not run here. resolves: clients is each declared team's client, default the client of any other team. refuses: goSays is part of the Go refusal; the Python raises Refused or CouldNotEstablish.

resolves.name: the home-level setting only
resolves.hostVars:
agent_bus_matrix_client: element
agent_bus_element_teams:
  - team: alpha
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6167

resolves.name: a team override
resolves.hostVars:
agent_bus_element_teams:
  - team: alpha
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6167
  - team: beta
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6168
    client: element

resolves.name: an override back to lightning
resolves.hostVars:
agent_bus_matrix_client: 'element'  # trying it
agent_bus_element_teams:
  - team: alpha
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6167
    client: lightning

refuses.name: a home-level value
refuses.goSays: agent_bus_matrix_client is 'nheko'; the client must be element or lightning

refuses.name: an empty home-level value
refuses.goSays: agent_bus_matrix_client is ''; the client must be element or lightning

refuses.name: a team's value
refuses.hostVars:
agent_bus_element_teams:
  - team: alpha
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6167
    client: Lightning
refuses.goSays: team alpha's client is 'Lightning'; the client must be element or lightning

refuses.name: a team's value that is not text
refuses.hostVars:
agent_bus_element_teams:
  - team: alpha
    base_url: http://192.0.2.1:6167
    client: ["lightning"]
refuses.goSays: team alpha's client is ['lightning']; the client must be element or lightning

refuses.name: set twice
refuses.goSays: agent_bus_matrix_client is set more than once
